name: Whole30 Coconut Chicken Curry
desc: Chicken, sweet potato, green plantain, and carrots simmered in coconut milk and crushed tomatoes with curry powder, finished with baby kale.

source.title: Whole30 Coconut Chicken Curry
source.evidence: All eighteen ingredients and amounts match this page (1 1/2 lb chicken breast, 1 green plantain, 2 cans coconut milk, 24 oz crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp curry powder, 1 1/2 tsp dried cilantro) and the three steps follow it nearly word for word.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 (1-inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and minced
1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
1 green plantain, peeled, sliced into 1/2-inch rounds, and quartered
ingredients.prep: peeled, sliced into 1/2-inch rounds, and quartered

ingredients.raw: 3 small carrots, peeled and sliced into rounds
2 (14 oz) cans full-fat coconut milk, shaken
3 tbsp curry powder, or more to taste

steps: Heat the coconut oil in a large heavy-bottomed skillet or Dutch oven over medium-low heat until shimmering. Add the chicken and cook, tossing so it does not stick, until no longer pink in the center (165°F), about 7 min. Move the chicken to a bowl.
Add the onions, bell pepper, jalapeño, garlic, and ginger to the pan. Cook and stir until softened, about 7 min.
Add the sweet potato, plantain, and carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly tender, about 5 min.
Pour in the coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, and water and stir. Cover and cook at a gentle simmer until the flavors meld, about 30 min.

Stir in the kale, curry powder, salt, pepper, and dried cilantro, and return the chicken with any juices. Cover and cook at a gentle simmer until the sweet potatoes and carrots are soft, about 30 min more. Taste and add more curry powder if you like.
tips: The Allrecipes steps set the browned chicken aside and never say to add it back; this version returns it with the kale.
1 tbsp black pepper is a lot of heat on top of the jalapeño; start with 1 1/2 tsp and add more at the end if you want it.
